title: KinderCare Expands to Arkansas with Opening of New Bentonville Early Learning Center
summary: First Arkansas location marks KinderCare’s 42nd state, bringing high-quality early childhood education and care to Arkansas families Key takeaways: KinderCare Learning Companies opened its first early childhood education center in Arkansas, bringing access to high-quality early childhood learning and care to families in Bentonville. Bentonville KinderCare serves children ages six weeks to five years old and provides a nurturing learning environment designed to help children build confidence, develop essential skills and prepare for kindergarten. The opening comes as Northwest Arkansas continues to grow, creating increased demand for reliable child care solutions that support working families and local employers. KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc. (NYSE: KLC) (“KinderCare”), the nation’s leading provider of high-quality early childhood education and care, today announced the opening of Bentonville KinderCare , its first child care center in Arkansas.
